design_description: A bold split-color design built around a clean half-and-half composition in deep green and bright yellow, creating a strong traditional football identity. The vertical division continues consistently across the front and back, giving the jersey a simple but instantly recognizable visual structure. Contrasting sleeves mirror the two-color concept, while orange-red cuff accents add a subtle additional layer of detail. The front keeps branding and sponsor elements prominent, while the back uses large red-and-white outlined name and numbering for maximum visibility. Overall, the jersey feels classic, direct, and distinctive, using strong color blocking rather than complex graphics to establish its identity.
